# Emily

## Overview

- **Role:** schoolteacher (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>  
  _previously: dressmaker (v1)_  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P1](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Emily is a smart, pretty, and petite woman.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)_

## Personality

Emily is characterized by her neat and tidy nature. She maintains a reputation as a pattern housekeeper and possesses her own financial means.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)_

## Traits

- neat and tidy (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>

## History

Early in her life, Emily worked as a schoolteacher, a background that permanently shaped her character. After arguments over housecleaning, grammar, and a swearing parrot named [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), she left her husband, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), and moved back to her own house. She eventually arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) looking for him, leading to their reconciliation and her joyful return to living with her husband.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P2](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P4](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P5](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P6](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P9](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), +97 more_

## Relationships

### [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--harrison.md)

Emily is the wife of Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), having married him three years prior to her arrival in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). The couple had previously separated due to frequent domestic arguments over housecleaning, grammar, and Mr. Harrison's swearing parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md). However, Emily eventually tracked him down at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), leading to their reconciliation and his admitted relief at her return.

- Spouse of — married three years ago (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P4](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0004)</sub>

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--rachel-lynde.md)

Emily shares a lifelong friendship with [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md). Upon arriving in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to reunite with her husband, Emily spent time accompanied by Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md). Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) subsequently helped spread the news and gossip regarding Emily's unexpected return throughout the community.

- Friend of — lifelong friendship (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047)</sub>
